text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (International Tax Compliance Agreements) (Competent Authority Agreements) (No. 2) Order 2017 and comes into operation on 27 February 2017.

heading.en: Declaration as international tax compliance agreements

text.en: 2. Each competent authority agreement specified in the Schedule is declared as an international tax compliance agreement for the purposes of Part XXB of the Act with effect from 27 February 2017.
